chunks: As for that which indicates that he will be from the offspring of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), the reports which we have cited regarding that the Imams are twelve and mentioned their details are inclusive of that,

and because whoever enumerated the number we mentioned said: The Mahdi is from the offspring of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him). And it is what we have alluded to. And that which increases its clarity is:
ai.seo_question: Why is Imam Mahdi considered to be from the descendants of Imam Husain?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi grounds the Mahdi's lineage in the foundational doctrine of the Twelve Imams, arguing that the specific enumeration of the Imams inherently necessitates the Mahdi's descent from Imam Husayn (a.s.). This establishes a direct theological link between the established chain of succession and the eschatological figure, reinforcing the certainty of his identity within Shia tradition.
